npcs.name: Your Mom
dialog: There you are! The truck beat us here.
Come inside. Your room is upstairs. The boxes can wait. Go set the clock first — a new home needs a correct time.
Good. Now go say hello next door. Hex's family just moved in too. You two will need each other out there.
Wait. Before you run off — here. Sprint Boots. Hold B and you can run. A trainer who cannot run will always be late.

npcs.name: Hex
dialog: You again? I already picked my starter. Razorgater, obviously.
Don't think I'll go easy on you just because we grew up here.
Next time we meet, we BATTLE. Count on it.

npcs.name: Technology Enthusiast
dialog: Technology is incredible!
You can now store up to 6 Mochiichao in your party!
Any more you catch are instantly sent to your PC!

npcs.name: Local Kid
dialog: I heard there's a branded Kittember in the tall grass near the woods...
It had a glowing 'H' burned into its side. Creepy.

npcs.name: Fisherman
dialog: The waters here are calm, but I've seen something HUGE moving deep below...
The old-timers call it Astroleviathan. I call it my nightmare.

npcs.name: Dock Fisher
dialog: You didn't see a runner, did you? Grey hood, fast feet?
He took my Pupbble right off the bay steps. Forty years I've fished this harbour. She's been beside me for nine of them.
They say he makes camp in the tall grass on Route 1. If you're headed that way... that's all. That's everything I have to ask with.

npcs.name: Pupbble
dialog: Pupbble: *contented yip, watching the water*

npcs.name: Mochii
dialog: Mochii: *a bright chirp at everyone who passes the lab door*

npcs.name: Street Ranger
dialog: That's MY partner he's fighting with. Say it plainly, or fight me for the right to.

npcs.name: Street Ranger
dialog: Mind your own battles, Ranger.

npcs.name: Net Mender
dialog: Mending nets is just knots, all the way down. Like most honest work.

npcs.name: Mochii
dialog: Mochi! Mochii~!
(The harbor Mochii watches the water. It seems to live here.)

npcs.name: Something in the Sand
dialog: Something green with salt is half-buried by the dock steps…

npcs.name: Shopkeeper
dialog: Harbor shop. If the boats can't bring it, I don't stock it, and the boats bring nearly everything.
You're Aeon's new one, by the bag. Take a Mend Patch on the house — the road to Silicon Town teaches why we sell them.
When I'm big I'm buying the whole red shelf. The whole one. I've counted it. It's forty-one.

signs.text:
BOOT HARBOR
Prof. Aeon's Lab is north — walk into the door.

TALL GRASS
Wild Mochiichao live here — bring a partner first!

BOOT HARBOR
The lab is north of here. Route 1.0 is north past the lab.

ROUTE 1.0 GATE
North to Route 1.0 and Silicon Town.
No partner yet? Go to Prof. Aeon's Lab first.
